game.tutorial: Safe hits more often and is worth less. Bold hits less and is worth more — it pays off once your attributes are high. Reckless never pays off on average, but carries the biggest prize. Closing it safe, however well you play it, never makes an iconic moment.

game.tutorialArcade: Every moment is a minigame. Good execution pushes the odds up, bad execution pushes them down — but the play's attribute still weighs more. A safe shot never becomes an iconic moment.

mg.hint.playbook: Tap a teammate to pass, a spot on the floor to drive. Shoot when you're open. When nobody moves the play freezes: redraw and press RUN.
mg.hint.shot: Drag the ball back and release, slingshot style. The defender is a standing obstacle: clear his hand.
mg.hint.defense: Hold A/D (or ◀ ▶) to shadow him · S (or Space) steals when the ball is exposed · W (or ▲) arms your hand.
mg.ready.title: READY?
mg.rules.playbook:
READ (2s): the defense shows up. No drawing yet.
DRAW (no clock): drag the red magnets to trace routes, or pick a template. Tap a magnet with a route = it ends in a screen.
PASS (before RUN): pick the teammate and the moment — EARLY (as it runs), NORMAL (halfway), LATE (end of the play).
RUN (12s shot clock): the play goes live. Tap a teammate = pass · tap the floor = drive.
FEINT = dribble move: for 0.6s you are 0.8m more open (handles); 6% chance to lose the ball. PUMP FAKE = your man within 1.2m jumps for 0.7s and stops counting; 15% he lands on you: foul, free throws.
When nobody moves the play FREEZES (clock stops): redraw the routes and press RUN. Only SHOOT works while frozen.
SHOOT: odds = your skill for that shot × OPENNESS. Low openness = automatic offensive rebound (your rebounding vs their rebounder) — the ball can land with any teammate.
mg.rules.shot:
Drag the ball back and release: the direction and length of the pull become the arc. The dots show the start of the flight — the better your attribute, the farther you see.
The defender STANDS STILL with his hand up: a ball that goes under it is blocked.
Your attribute (finishing up close, handles at mid-range, three from deep) also steadies the aim — a low attribute shakes more.
Distance and ball height change every moment. Very close to the rim = finish.
mg.rules.defense:
He's coming with the ball. Stay in front: hold A / D (or the arrow keys) to slide. On mobile, swipe on the stage.
S (or Space, or ▼) = steal — only counts with the ball exposed (lit ball); the odds are your defense. Otherwise it's a miss, and the 2nd miss is a foul.
W (or ▲) = CONTEST: arms your hand. If he really rises, you get a block chance (defense). If he fakes, you bite and he drives — or draws a foul. The stance lasts ~1s: re-arm.
The TENDENCIES card tells you when to arm. The possession lasts ~9s.
